title: Walking into a room and forgetting why

narrator.style: clear, clean, crisp studio voice with precise articulation, smooth, not breathy, not raspy; dry deadpan narrator, slightly unimpressed, natural pace

theo.style: clear, clean voice, not breathy, not raspy; cheeky young guy roasting his friend, trying not to laugh

lines.say: You walk into the kitchen with purpose.
Like a man on a mission.
You arrive. And your brain just logs out.
Why are you here? Nobody knows.
So you open the fridge. Maybe the answer is in there.
It's not. It's ketchup and disappointment.
You stand there for thirty seconds, like a confused fucking houseplant.
So you walk back to the sofa to reboot. Like a shitty old laptop.
And Theo saw the whole thing.
Bro, you just did a lap. You're a Roomba in a hoodie.
You sit down. And instantly, you remember.
You wanted a glass of water. That's it. Water.
You get up. Halfway there, Theo yells.
Grab me a snack while you're up, dumbass!
And just like that, it's gone again.
So you turn around, and walk into the kitchen with purpose.
